episode_summary: In this episode, mindset coach Paul Salter discusses the pitfalls of using success to prove self-worth and the importance of recalibrating ambition for sustainable success. He offers insights into shifting success metrics from financial to personal fulfillment and the emotional costs of high achievement. Salter emphasizes the need to separate personal identity from professional accomplishments to achieve true freedom and fulfillment.
